methods.joint_peaks: absolute drive torque and joint speed, all 4000 physics samples including censored tail; also successful full cycles separately
methods.air: longest contiguous interval with total positive normal ground Fz <10 N in [1.0,2.3] s, at least 3 physics samples; threshold is descriptive
methods.takeoff_vz: linear interpolation of base COM world vertical velocity at first airborne physics sample; not whole robot COM
methods.push_impulse: normal Fz integrated from phase 1.0s up to but excluding first airborne sample; includes wheel, foot, thigh, shank normal forces; excludes friction
methods.symmetry: RMS of (qL+qR)-(refqL+refqR), no half factor; successful full cycles, phase [1.0,1.8]s; reference advanced one control frame for post-physics alignment
methods.comparison: same seed42, 1env,1000 steps; 5 repeated complete cycles are not independent seeds; runtime material/mass/COM equality checked; multiple training changes confound causality

reference.note: NPZ base link velocity is kinematic link-origin velocity; telemetry base velocity is COM velocity, not exact matching point.
